colleges.notes: Same figures in the 2026-27 prospectus (PDF p.19 = printed p.14; scanned). Also: Student Amenities and Services fee 50,000 per annum; refundable security deposit 3,00,000 one-time; University Registration Fee Rs. 22,500 once (prospectus p.15); NRI total at admission printed as 'USD … + INR 6,50,000.00'; NRI paying in INR pays at the USD rate of the payment date. Prospectus p.16 note: this 'minimum fee structure' will be revised for the other 50% of seats if 50% are fixed at the Government college fee — subject to Supreme Court W.P.(C) 682/2023. Fee concession for Bihar domicile SC/ST/BC/EBC/women/EWS under s.36(2) Bihar Private Universities Act 2013 (not on NRI seats). BCECEB PGMAC-2026 prospectus §8.2: Health Dept Resolution 840(1) dt 19.08.2026 (50% private seats at govt fee) 'kept in abeyance' after Patna High Court order of 05.08.2026. Psychiatry, ENT, Ophthalmology, preclinical and Pathology/Community Medicine have no NRI fee ('--').
